title: kernel-v1 local storage & standalone dev API envelope (v1)
description: Versioned source of truth for the numeric constants that govern the SQLCipher local history/outbox (task 24) and the standalone node service + local REST/WebSocket API + CLI dev bind surface (task 26). Tasks reference the schema path rather than hardcoding numbers inline; any number not anchored here is a plan defect.

default_local_retention_seconds.description: Default local retention window in seconds for acknowledged events/batches before deletion (task 24).

default_local_retention_bytes.description: Default local retention budget in bytes for the encrypted SQLite database (task 24).

default_loopback_dev_bind.description: Loopback bind host for the standalone dev API. The no-auth dev surface MUST only ever bind to a loopback host; a non-loopback bind (e.g. 0.0.0.0) is rejected by a strict check (task 26).

default_dev_port.description: Default TCP port for the standalone dev REST/WebSocket API (task 26).

default_drain_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds the agent may spend draining the ring buffer and flushing local storage on SIGTERM/SIGINT before it returns a typed timeout error (task 26).

default_page_limit.description: Default page size for bounded paginated API queries (task 26).

max_page_limit.description: Hard upper bound on a single page size. A requested limit above this is rejected as an oversized filter (task 26).

max_page_window.description: Hard upper bound on (cursor offset + limit). Paginating deeper than this is rejected as an oversized filter so results are always bounded (task 26).

max_filter_bytes.description: Hard upper bound on the byte length of a single filter value (kind/qname/path/syscall/cursor). A longer value is rejected as an oversized filter (task 26).

websocket_broadcast_capacity.description: Bounded capacity of the live-event broadcast channel. A slow consumer that falls behind by more than this many messages is shed (typed rejection) without crashing the server (task 26).
